definitions.explanation: A number in the hundreds — one that has three places (100–999). {桁|けた} counts digits or decimal places, so {三桁|さんけた} means three places.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三桁|さんけた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧だ。
examples.english: The password is a three-digit number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに{三桁|さんけた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Sales finally reached three digits (the hundreds).

examples.japanese: ⟦{二桁|ふたけた}→二桁：15881_futaketa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掛|か}け{算|ざん}→掛け算：05334_kakezan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三桁|さんけた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Multiplying two-digit numbers can give a three-digit answer.

notes:
⟦{桁|けた}→桁：03884_keta⟧ means a digit or decimal place, so {三桁|さんけた} is a number with three places — the hundreds, from 100 to 999. The pattern extends to other counts of digits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三桁|さんけた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧: a three-digit number
- {三桁|さんけた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to reach three digits (the hundreds)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{二桁|ふたけた}→二桁：15881_futaketa⟧: two digits (10–99)
- {四桁|よんけた}: four digits (1,000–9,999)
